title: Serverware native ingress client configuration v3
description: Closed configuration original, at most 16384 bytes, for one fixed native-ingress quotation exchange using a controller-generated session challenge and explicit client-trust-v2 session evidence. The independently pinned workloadIssuer is a canonical single-certificate PEM (at most 65536 bytes, DER at most 16384 bytes); genuine verification joins it to the quoted runtime DER trust inventory and verifies the exact configured client chain under only that anchor. The independently pinned sessionScope is nonce-free; sessionExpectations and challengeSource are not accepted. Shape does not establish pin provenance, release admission, private-key isolation, CA installation permission or action authority. Runtime validates canonical endpoint/path spelling, actual held files, signatures and the actual TLS session.

endpoint.description: Canonical literal SocketAddr with nonzero port, not a hostname. Runtime rejects unspecified, multicast, broadcast and scoped IPv6 destinations, including mapped IPv4 exclusions; private and loopback literals remain permitted. This spelling pattern is not an IP parser or route-admission rule.

sessionScope.description: Independently pinned serverware.nativeIngressSessionScope/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes. It fixes the complete expected session scope but contains no nonce; the controller generates the challenge for this exchange rather than loading it from this artifact.

workloadIssuer.description: Independently selected public workload issuer original, never learned from the response. Exact DER membership in the quote-authenticated ordered root inventory is required. This PEM artifact hash is not the native framed-DER bundle hash.

clientPrivateKey.description: Independently pinned private-key original. Runtime additionally requires a bounded canonical PKCS8 PEM and owner-only, single-link regular file owned by root or the effective caller. A hash is not secret storage or hardware custody.

path.description: Exact absolute path without traversal, repeated separators, trailing separators or dot components. Runtime enforces a 4096-byte path cap, canonical filesystem equality and no-follow acquisition of every component; schema shape alone cannot establish those properties.
